FN-4MWA3IR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 312
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 312 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections
(DOC) and the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined amount to allow inmates to
attend parole hearings virtually.

FN-4MWA3IR-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 312
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/02/2024
Senate Bill 312 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase the obligations of the
Department of Corrections (DOC) and the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined
amount beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 to allow inmates victims, victim's families, and crime
victim's advocates to participate in parole hearings virtually or via telephone.
